schema.description:
Associates one or more Emission Factor to an Emission Activity; can be used to define a Factor for the
activity belonging to a specific Facility and its Equipment.

Note: Another way to associate a Factor to an Activity is through the Activity Argument Value. This
entity can have the argument type Emission Activity Parameter or Emission Factor. When defining
a value for an Emission Factor Argument Type, the Emission Activity Parameter ID can be used to
define the foreign activity.
schema.title: Emission Activity Factor

emission_activity_id.description: Foreign Key of the Emission Activity joined to an Emission Factor.

emission_factor_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Emission Factor joined to an Emission Activity.

unit_of_measure_id.description: DEPRECATED, the Unit Of Measure should be identified by the parent Emission Factor.

emission_factor_type_id.description: The optional part of a Foreign Key identifying the Emission Factor (the Emission Factor Type).

id.description: The Primary Key assigned to the Emission Activity Factor.

emission_activity_type_id.description: The optional part of a composite Foreign Key identifying the Emission Factor (the Emission Activity Type).
